stories.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
stories.body: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

stories.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
stories.body: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops in an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region.

stories.title: Myanmar faces historic genocide verdict at UN court over Rohingya massacres
stories.body: No state has ever been found guilty by an international court of committing genocide.

stories.title: Claude-maker Anthropic poised for more than $1.4tn stock market debut
stories.body: Anthropic started just five years ago an is now one of the biggest names in artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
stories.body: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.

stories.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
stories.body: Hamas condemns the incursion, which the Israeli military says is dismantling a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

stories.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russian official says
stories.body: The head of Crimea said traffic was suspended after another attack on the link between Russia and the occupied territory.

stories.title: Russian arrested for spying on US defence company Palantir over Ukraine support
stories.body: The suspect followed employees and was found with fake US IDs and two Russian passports, prosecutors say.

stories.title: Parents jailed for torture and death of four-year-old girl found along French motorway in 1987
stories.body: Inass Touloub's body was found along the A10 road in 1987, bearing marks of abuse, and was not identified until 2018.

stories.title: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up India tour
stories.body: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize

stories.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
stories.body: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.

stories.title: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
stories.body: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.

stories.title: Democrats nominate Hakeem Jeffries to be US Speaker of the House
stories.body: The nomination sets him on the path to become the first black lawmaker to lead the chamber when Democrats take control of the House in January.

stories.title: Julio Iglesias facing court investigation over alleged sexual offences
stories.body: The 83-year-old singer is accused of abusing two former employees at Caribbean residences in 2021.

stories.title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
stories.body: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.

stories.title: Bancroft sandpaper claims heap pressure on Cummins
stories.body: Cameron Bancroft claims the whole Australia team knew about the 2018 sandpaper plot in explosive revelations that will heap pressure on current captain Pat Cummins.

stories.title: British hacker who stole $11m through text message scheme jailed for six years in US
stories.body: Tyler Buchanan, from Dundee, was a member of the notorious Scattered Spider group and began hacking when he was a teenager.

stories.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales
stories.body: The AI chip giant reported strong quarterly earnings on Tuesday after the dramatic exit of Jensen Huang.

stories.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways
stories.body: The decision comes after California banned Waymo's driverless vehicles from operating on the state's highways following a series of traffic incidents.

stories.title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
stories.body: Asif Merchant was found guilty in March of trying to hire undercover FBI agents as hitmen to assassinate US officials, including the president.
